---
name: Enhancement
about: Propose a new capability, directive, or design decision for a future version
title: "[enhancement] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Motivation
What use case or gap is not served by the current profile? Reference `spec.md` §11
("Out of scope for v0.1") if this is a known deferred item.

## Proposal
Describe the change. If it affects normative behavior, sketch the directive/payload/state
changes and how they map onto core A2A.

## Compatibility
How does this interact with extension negotiation and graceful degradation (§9)? Does it
require a new extension URI version? See `GOVERNANCE.md`.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches and why this one is preferred.
